AMENDMENT_12_THE_REPORTING_REQUIREMENT_F.THE_SENTENCE: A test that cannot attain its own threshold has measured nothing about the arms -- it has measured the calendar.
required_beside_ANY_inconclusive_verdict: the ATTAINABLE MINIMUM p at the G actually achieved (not the G planned)
the TOLERANCE at the G actually achieved: how many negative days the test could have survived and still cleared
both computed from the G that actually completed, because a failed-quality day lowers G and moves both numbers
AMENDMENT_12_THE_REPORTING_REQUIREMENT_F.why_the_tolerance_belongs_beside_it: the minimum p tells a reader whether a pass was POSSIBLE. The tolerance tells them HOW CLOSE TO PERFECTION IT DEMANDED. An INCONCLUSIVE from a test that required 7-for-7 is a different fact from one that allowed slack, and a reader cannot tell them apart from the verdict alone.
